properties.Observation: large dent on slab, mosses has been spread on slab which is not good for concrete.
properties.Description:
Clean around the slab

Chip loose concrete, remove the loose particle and finally remove the dust

Apply a bonding agent on dent

Rendering 19mm thick in cement sand Motar 1:3 mix (Smooth finish)

Waterproofing with cementitious waterproofing agent appro
